title: Success Rate for Job Matching on MyCareersFuture.sg
what_it_is: Success Rate for Job Matching on MyCareersFuture.sg

sections.label: Jobs Bank 2017 postings
sections.summary: In 2017 over 20,000 employers posted jobs on Jobs Bank, receiving over two million local applications, with SMEs accounting for over 60% of postings.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: In 2017, more than 20,000 employers placed job postings on the Jobs Bank, of which a small minority were to fulfil the Fair Consideration Framework advertising requirements.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: In total, these job postings received more than two million applications from local jobseekers.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: As employers may not update the outcome of their job postings, we are not yet able to capture all job matches facilitated by Jobs Bank or MyCareersFuture.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: Small and medium enterprises accounted for more than 60% of job postings on the Jobs Bank in 2017.

sections.label: Jobs Bank listings and jobseekers
sections.summary: Fair Consideration Framework listings became a minority on Jobs Bank, with nearly a quarter million job postings and about two million applications in 2017.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: We want to take a look at whether they are putting jobs up as listings and, for this, we also compare ourselves with other portals.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: And I think what has been most encouraging is that although it started as a portal for you to post jobs for which the employer may potentially be hiring an Employment Pass holder for – to fulfil the advertising requirement under the Fair Consideration Framework – in fact, now, those kinds of job listings are a minority.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: So, what this tells us is that the employers are finding it useful to post the other jobs which they are not required to do under the Fair Consideration Framework.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: The other metric that, of course, we track is the number of jobseekers who go online.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: I can share some of our Jobs Bank statistic for 2017.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: The total number of job postings is nearly a quarter million and the number of jobseekers, I think I mentioned, there were about two million applications.
